item.text:
Implemented Task 012 and committed it as `1b390398636c740abbf288e9eeab6799383f7590`.

Tasks now keep a persistent position for each project they have visited. First-time arrivals append; returning tasks resume their saved positions. Existing task order is preserved by the startup migration.

Verified with `node --check`, `git diff --check`, and an API check covering return order, first-time arrivals, health, and persistence after restart. The working tree is clean.

Run with `npm start`; set `PORT` and `DB_PATH` as needed.
